title: Stem Cells
description: A cell that can become any other, waiting to be told which. The seed of every organ, and of regrowing one. Unlocks the Regeneration Tank.

puzzle.goal: A culture of stem cells doubles every d days. Write how many, M, there are after t days, from a start of N.
puzzle.name: Doubling count
puzzle.ask: Find M for N = @{N}, t = @{t} and h = 2.
puzzle.method: Each doubling time multiplies the count by two: an exponential, until something tells them to stop and become.
